description: Queue a manual run of an active monitor now via POST /api/v1/monitors/:monitorId/runs. Spends credits; one manual run per monitor per cooldown, and none while a run is queued or running. Returns runId and status; read results with get_results. Requires monitors:write. Hosted MCP asks a person to approve the run first.

projectSlug.description: Optional; must match the monitor's project.

projectUuid.description: Optional; must match the monitor's project.

name: run_monitor
title: Run monitor
